Name: Joja Gold MegaClock (Animated)
Author: LeelooStardew
Description:
Introducing the Joja Gold MegaClock! Why settle for an ordinary Gold Clock when you could enjoy a premium gold Joja monument, complete with an animated stock graph display? Now you can monitor Joja Corp's market performance from the comfort of your very own farm!

There is an optional file download for any route/non-Joja members. Do not install both versions at the same time.

[b]Features[/b]
Replaces the Gold Clock with a Joja Corp-inspired gold monument.
Includes an animated stock graph display.
Does not modify the price or function of the Gold Clock.

[b]Requirements
[/b]SMAPI
Content Patcher
Content Patcher Animations
